dedupe_keys.name: globolakes global inland water distances and identifiers version 1

description: The University of Reading provides a global inland-water reference collection through CEDA under the GloboLakes project. Four related products describe distance to land, distance to water, water-body identifiers and lake-centre coordinates on a 1/360 degree grid, approximately 300 metres. They derive from the ESA Climate Change Initiative water-body mask based on Envisat observations during 2005–2010 and connect identified lakes to Global Lakes and Wetlands Database identifiers. CEDA lists NetCDF and BADC-CSV files, free under the Open Government Licence version 3; data access requires a registered account. The layers can support reservoir exposure screening and prepare spatial boundary information for catchment and lake simulations. They complement GLWD with coherent distances and lake locations. This static release does not represent subsequent shoreline changes, and identifiers depend on successful matching to GLWD. Resolution and mask limitations matter around narrow or changing water bodies. No data files or account-gated access were tested.
